WITH pairs AS (
  SELECT ab.translink, t.tradekind, COUNT(*) as rec_count 
  FROM advancedbehavior ab 
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg 
  JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg 
  GROUP BY ab.translink, t.tradekind
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    tradekind,
    rec_count,
    rec_count * 1.0 / SUM(rec_count) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) as share
  FROM pairs
),
type_avg AS (
  SELECT tradekind, AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM shares
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
enriched AS (
  SELECT 
    s.tradekind, 
    s.rec_count, 
    s.share,
    t.avg_share,
    s.share - t.avg_share as excess
  FROM shares s
  JOIN type_avg t ON s.tradekind = t.tradekind
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT tradekind, rec_count, share, excess
  FROM enriched
  WHERE share > avg_share
)
SELECT 
  tradekind,
  AVG(rec_count) as avg_rec_count,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(excess) as avg_excess
FROM filtered
GROUP BY tradekind
ORDER BY tradekind
